integrity: The exact value follows from a reconstructed proof of the source identity Omega'(X)=9/10 gamma_X(1/3), an exact convex-polytope reduction, exhaustive rational evaluation of all 36 vertex pairs, and a direct attaining isosceles pair.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the affine-regular hexagonal plane. It does not classify the generalized constant on all Radon planes or all hexagonal norms; absolute literature uniqueness cannot be guaranteed by finite search.
title: Exact generalized isosceles constant of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
